digest.component_or_area: source-code reference lookup workflow (Serena vs grep) and rebar project overlay
propositions: The existing AGENTS.md guidance to prefer Serena symbol tools over grep was present but ineffective; an agent enumerated call sites by hand with grep.
Serena symbol tools were deferred behind a ToolSearch discovery step, making grep cheaper and the default winner regardless of documentation.
Serena/Pyright cannot resolve symbols referenced as string literals (e.g. monkeypatch.setattr), missing real call sites that grep finds.
Serena's index can lag recent edits, reporting stale line numbers, while grep produces false positives on comment mentions.
Add a non-blocking PreToolUse Bash hook that surfaces a short Serena reminder on every grep-family invocation.
Add a project-only rebar criterion and coaching move directing re-derivation of hand-enumerated source references via Serena, scoped to the .rebar overlay.
